problem: High value enterprise deals are managed over email, so buyers and sellers lack a shared view of the plan, tasks and status of the deal.
business_model: B2B SaaS for sales teams (pricing not found)
product_category: Customer-facing deal collaboration, mutual action plans

technical_complexity.rationale: A shared web workspace for deal plans is standard SaaS engineering for a three person team, with integrations as the main extra work.

defensibility.rationale: The concept of a mutual action plan is a sales practice that rivals such as GetAccept later packaged as a feature; the YC page and search results show no data, network or integration moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Later comparison pages show digital sales room vendors offering mutual action plans as a feature, but the dated position in 2020 was not found. The company itself was acquired by an undisclosed buyer.

market_need_then: The YC description cites complex enterprise deals run over email; no dated spend or complaint data was found.

branding.domain_note: sameplan.com was the company site; it no longer resolves from this environment.

brand_strength.rationale: Searches found no press, community or brand material about Sameplan; the name is a plain compound of same and plan.

outcome_analysis: Sameplan was a three person Summer 2020 company building a customer-facing deal room for enterprise sales. The YC directory lists it as acquired, but no acquirer, date, price or funding rounds were found in public sources, so the story behind the exit is unknown. A Dealroom enterprise value estimate of 500 to 750 thousand dollars suggests a small outcome, but that is an unverified third-party estimate.
